messages:
ash: FYI customer reported failing SSO logins + SCIM errors after this morning's infra rollout. errors: id_token aud mismatch + scim provisioning 422 on create.

nora: can you dump an example id_token and scim payload? suspect audience claim changed when we flipped the service name.

ash: pasted minimal traces: 

```
2026-04-02T08:02:10Z WARN auth/oidc handler: id_token rejected: aud claim ["redwood-v2"] not in allowed_aud ["redwood-internal"] req=rt-42
2026-04-02T08:02:12Z ERROR scim/provisioner create status=422 body=\"invalid_encrypted_extid\" req=rt-42
```

jess: interesting both point to a deploy that changed two things: (1) auth proxy now emits aud=redwood-v2 after the rename; (2) scim envelope encryption updated to include `enc-version` header that our old decrypt path doesn't parse. rollout notes mentioned both.

kms-bot: NOTE: key policy update applied to alias/tenant-keys at 2026-04-02T07:50:03Z. Change applied: allow service-account:scim-worker to use GenerateDataKey. change-id=kp-20260402-15

ash: that could explain scim error (permission) or the newer envelope header. jess, can we validate if decrypt fails due to access denied vs unsupported header?

jess: ran a local decrypt attempt against the blob (debug-only): response was AccessDenied on GenerateDataKey, not parse error. stack: `kms.exceptions.AccessDenied: not authorized to call GenerateDataKey with key arn:aws:kms:...:cmk-AAA`

nora: so key policy change removed grant for scim-worker. do we have a cached grant or IAM role mapping?

ash: checked IAM: scim-worker uses an assumed role `svc-scim-prod` which previously relied on a KMS key policy statement `Sid=AllowScimWorker`. the policy entry was replaced by a narrower principal that references `svc-scim-v2` (new role). rollout swapped service roles but a subset of pods still run as old role. mismatch -> AccessDenied.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-442 (sev3) by ash: impacted customers: 3 tenant orgs; authentication failures and scim creates failing. assigned to @jess and @nora.

jess: mitigation plan: 1) re-add `svc-scim-prod` to key policy temporarily; 2) patch a sidecar that translates enc-version header to legacy format (short-term); 3) coordinate auth-proxy rollback if aud rename is widespread.

nora: quick check: are login failures caused by aud rename only for clients pinned to redwood-internal? we should add an aud-accept list for backward compat.

ash: rolling key policy rollback now (manual) to re-grant GenerateDataKey to svc-scim-prod. will monitor.

kms-bot: key policy update queued: rollback-req by ash at 2026-04-02T08:11:20Z (change-ref kp-rollback-20260402-01).

ash: rollback applied. scim-worker logs show decrypt success and scim create flows resumed for the queued requests.

jess: confirmed: decrypt ok. however id_token aud mismatch still blocking some SSO flows. I can push a compat change that accepts both aud values for 7 days.

nora: prefer make auth-proxy accept multiple aud values and emit a warning metric, then schedule full client communication for the rename. Backport compat to the hosted auth-proxy and auth SDKs.

ash: agreed. I'm marking immediate mitigations done: key rollback + accept-aud compat. Will open follow-ups: 1) Key policy change gating in deploy CI (require canary test); 2) envelope-version negotiation test in SCIM integration suite; 3) rollout checklist entry for service principal rename.

jess: creating SEC-2026-114 in tracker for follow-ups and action owners. assigning: keys -> nora, auth -> jess, scim -> ash.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-442 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev3, duration=39m.

ash: small postmortem note: root cause = simultaneous infra rename (auth-proxy aud) + KMS key policy change that mismatched running pod roles; contributing factor = insufficient canary/compat tests for key policy deltas.

nora: + add automated diff-checker that rejects key policy changes that remove principals currently active in prod (detect via IAM role usage logs). I'll prototype.

jess: also adding a deployment hook: `pre-deploy smoke` that validates scim worker can decrypt a sample blob using the new policy.

ash: thanks team. will add a short blameless summary in eng-all and link SEC-2026-114.
